narrative_summary: Structural bias holds at Late Bull / Topping: a mechanically intact skeleton (50d > 200d, +7.85% over the 200-day, benign sub-17 VIX) is colliding with a stalling rally. The 14-session snap-back tagged the 23.6% fib (7,498) but faded to a weak bottom-third close at 7,483, ~1.3% below the 6/15 swing high, while Monte Carlo flipped back to 59.6% down-first and fails every threshold. ERP sits at the 0.48% valuation ceiling with forward PE 20.2x, and breadth (McClellan ~889) plus credit (junk spread 1.35%) still refuse to confirm the recovery. Trim bias into strength/resistance — not chasing the rally toward the swing high — remains the only justified posture.
